Subject: Security & Evidence Roadmap — SableBank discovery recap

Amelia / Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we have a shared checklist and owners. High-level notes below (pulled from our call):

Pain points & goals
- SOC 2: SableBank wants Redwood in-scope for SOC 2 Type II for data residency + processing controls; anticipated audit window Q1 2027.
- Audit logs & retention: primary ask is immutable audit logs retained for 7 years for certain payment-related flows; secondary ask is short-term (90 day) query retention for operational debugging.
- DPA scope: customer-specific DPA changes (data subprocessor list + deletion SLA) — legal will want a redline.
- Pen test evidence: SableBank needs the last 12 months of penetration test summaries, remediation timelines, and our pentest provider contact.
- Separation of duties: requirement to isolate audit-log exports to a read-only S3 bucket owned by SableBank (or pushing signed hashes to their ledger).

What Redwood can provide (next-step deliverables)
- Artifact bundle: SOC 2 evidence index + recent pen test summary + high-level KMS diagram. (Owner: Laura Bennett; ETA: 3 business days)
- Retention spec: proposed audit-log schema and retention policy options (owner: Rishi Malhotra; ETA: 5 business days)
- DPA redline: our standard DPA with proposed language for deletion SLA and subprocessors (owner: Legal — I will loop in ops/legal after this message; ETA: 4 business days)
- Proof-of-concept for read-only export: small demo that exports sanitized audit events to a customer-owned S3 bucket (owner: Marissa Cole / Solutions; ETA: 2 weeks if we get access details)

Immediate asks from your side
- Amelia: confirm the compliance contact and legal reviewer (name + email) we should route the DPA to.
- Evan: can you confirm whether the 7-year retention applies to all token-level logs or a scoped subset (payments & reconciliation only)?

Attachments I’m sending with this thread:
- sable_soc2-questionnaire.xlsx (your completed questionnaire + our notes)
- redwood-evidence-index.pdf (template index we’ll populate)

Proposed next steps
- Laura & Rishi to produce the artifact bundle and retention spec. I’ll coordinate the DPA handoff to legal and schedule a follow-up call next Tuesday to review the artifact bundle and the export PoC.

If that aligns, I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 15 Sep 2026 09:00 PT.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Quoting a couple of items and adding technical clarifications for the record: 

> "SOC 2: SableBank wants Redwood in-scope for SOC 2 Type II for data residency + processing controls; anticipated audit window Q1 2027."

We can commit to providing the evidence index and recent control narratives. Two clarifications:
- Evidence coverage: our standard SOC 2 package covers production control environment and change management. For the 7-year retention ask we will need to scope the retention to specific event types (we typically carve out PII access logs vs. processing logs).
- Immutable exports: We support signed log export (SHA256 chain) to a customer-owned S3 bucket; to comply with your internal audit we’ll provide export manifests + proof of non-repudiation. Implementation will require an IAM role we can assume or customer-signed presigned URLs for uploads.

Deliverable plan (technical):
- Artifact bundle: PDF + index with sample artifact locations and masked screenshots. (ETA: 72 hours)
- Retention spec: two opt-in retention profiles (7-year full retention for payment events; 1-year for debug traces) with cost/throughput impact + sample retention lifecycle policy. (ETA: 5 business days)
- Pen test package: summary of last 12 months, remediation ticket IDs, remediation dates, and our third-party provider contact. Note: full pentest reports are shared under NDA — we’ll include executive summaries in the artifact bundle and can execute the NDA for full reports.

Action items for SableBank to accelerate
- Provide the compliance email + legal reviewer for DPA redline.
- Confirm scope of events for 7-year retention (payments only vs. payments + reconciliation).
- Provide an S3 bucket ARN or acceptance of presigned-upload flow for PoC.

I’ll start populating the redwood-evidence-index.pdf and attach a pen-test-scope-template.docx to this thread for your review.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Karthik / Laura —

Appreciate the thorough recap. Confirming the following from SableBank’s side:
- Compliance reviewer will be Claire Donovan (claire.donovan@sablebank.com). I’ll loop legal once we have Redwood’s DPA redline.
- The 7-year requirement applies to payment transaction audit logs and reconciliation traces only — not to ephemeral debug traces.
- We are fine with an S3-based export for the PoC; I’ll get the bucket ARN to you by EOD Friday and Claire will share the NDA template for the pentest report.

Two quick clarifying questions:
1) Is the SOC 2 artifact bundle the same package you share with other financial customers, or do you customize narratives for control exceptions?
2) For the read-only export PoC, can you confirm the option to sign exports with a customer-provided KMS key? We’d prefer keys under our control if possible.

If you can answer those two items in your artifact bundle, we’ll be ready to move to an evidence review call next Tuesday.

Thanks —
